purpose: One box of an InputOTP, showing a single character or the caret while it is the active empty slot. InputOTP draws it and reads the code from it.

notFor.case: Standalone use outside a code field.

Default.visual: Fill of the variant (Surface/input, Surface/muted or Surface/page) with a Border/control or Border/subtle edge.

Filled.visual: The Default look with the character in Content/primary.

Typing.visual: Border/focus edge, Border/ring/default halo and the caret in Content/primary.

Focused.meaning: The active slot, already holding a character.

a11y.role: none (presentational; the hidden input inside InputOTP carries the value and label)
a11y.keyboard: Not focusable on its own; InputOTP's input handles every key.
notes: The edge moves with use-hover and the halo with use-focus.

openQuestions: Reduced motion: should the slot's edge and halo transitions (use-hover, use-focus) and the caret blink stop with reduced motion?
Digit property: in the filled and underline variants Figma's digit text is not bound to the Digit property (always "7"). Should Figma be fixed, or is it a known file quirk?
